svg.aria-label: Orientation and phase mapping: the measured peaks are transformed to polar coordinates, correlated with a library of simulated patterns over the fundamental zone axis wedge, the best in-plane angle is found from the correlation, and refinement and a phase decision give the orientation and phase maps
